items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: Well after, well I began to be a member of Paul's band then.

ctx.x: Talk about playing with Kid Howard there for a while and then you played bass.

Yeah, when I left I played with this boy I was talking about, Don Ramon. Well, I didn't play too long with him. But finally, Paul Barbaran, he gets in the jam for bass playing. You see, Stuart Davis was playing bass with him and he had a job going out of town. You see? Yeah. And Stuart didn't want to go. We could find a bass player right away and Albert Walters told him, he said, well why don't you get Richard? Because he had heard me play with Howard, you see?
